# CANDIDATE: VWAP_FADE_ORB_SWEEP

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

After an opening range sweep, price tends to revert to the day's VWAP as liquidity rebalances. The edge exists because OR sweeps often represent liquidity grabs or stop hunts, followed by a mean-reversion move toward the intraday VWAP as institutional algorithms rebalance inventory.

## Mechanism

Entry: Within first 30 minutes, if price breaks above OR high by >0.5*ATR(5) and then closes below VWAP for two consecutive 1-minute bars, enter short symmetric (break below OR low by >0.5*ATR(5) then two closes above VWAP for long). Exit: Initial stop at opposite OR extreme (OR low for shorts, OR high for longs); first target at VWAP; after reaching 0.5R, trail stop 15% off highest/lowest price since entry. Regime filter: Only trade when VIX <20 and |EMA8-EMA21| <0.05*price (flat ribbon, choppy conditions).
